mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to its 5-year median compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of observations where FEDFUNDS is below its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a three-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points in a single month signals increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises >0.1pp in 1 month during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 5-year median indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS is above its 5-year median.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month low indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, triggering concerns about economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below its 12-month low.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals persistent inflation and inadequate monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% in a single month signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines by >5% in a month.
